thread:
sam: heads-up: small perf regression on host ingress after yesterday's kernel selector tweak. p95 CPU up ~10% for parse+tokenize path
nina: where's the signal? traces or dashboard?
sam: traces first. lots of short-lived syscalls and repeated kv.lock spikes in the critical path. attaching quick trace summary
```
trace-abcde: ingress -> header_parse(14%) -> pretokenize.normalize(9%) -> tokenize(22%) -> writev(13%) -> kv_shard_evict(7%)
```
rory: normalize? we rolled a utf8-normalize micro-optimization last week but it had a fallback path. could be hitting fallback often
kevin: earlier kernel selector change also switched to a "thin-kv" kernel for low-latency ops. thinner KV segments = more evictions if access pattern is bursty
nina: so two potential contributors: normalize extra work + more kv churn from kernel choice -> causes tokenization to run more often + more writev fragments (hpacks churn)
sam: exactly. also noticed mean header bytes up ~30% for certain clients after we started adding routing metadata to headers (X-Routing-Info). that increases HPACK table churn and more small frames
rory: can we validate with two small toggles on canary: (A) disable X-Routing-Info header emission, (B) force kernel selector to use "wide-kv" variant?
kevin: i can flip kernel flag. nina can toggle header emission. run both separately + together and compare p95 for tokenize + writev counts
ina: starting header-off canary now. eng-bot will show deploy events
eng-bot: canary deploy started by nina at 2026-03-20 11:05 UTC
sam: also add temporary gauges: `ingress.writev_count`, `hpacks.table_replacements`, `kv.evictions_per_minute` to help correlate without full traces
ina: header-off result: writev_count -18%, header bytes -28%, tokenize unchanged
kevin: kernel-wide result: tokenize p95 -9%, kv.evictions -60%
sam: combined toggles bring p95 back to baseline. strong signal: both layers contributed
rory: short-term mitigation: stop emitting X-Routing-Info by default and revert kernel selector to prefer wide-kv for 72h
kevin: agreed. long-term: adjust kernel selector scoring to include `kv_hit_rate` in the decision and make normalize lazy for ascii-only payloads
nina: opened PRs: r/ingress#433 (header opt-out), r/runtime#217 (kernel selector revert + scoring change), r/tokenize#198 (lazy normalize). CI looks green for all three
ina: apply patch to canary then /prod if metrics stay stable
eng-bot: r/ingress#433 merged by nina at 2026-03-20 11:42 UTC
sam: after revert, p95 back to pre-change numbers and writev counts down. marking follow-ups:
- TICKET-805: add HPACK and writev telemetry (owner: sam)
- TICKET-806: kernel selector RFC to incorporate kv_hit_rate (owner: rory)
- TICKET-807: optimize normalize path (owner: kevin)
nina: also recommend adding a small frame coalescer on the writev path to reduce syscall noise. logged as TICKET-808
sam: thanks all. great triage. closing thread once tickets created and rollout stable
kevin: thanks team :rocket:
